fusions.name: Plough Line
fusions.desc: You drive a furrow 5 tiles ahead, dealing 28 damage plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health to everything in it. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 7 damage, rising 10% for each ally near you (up to 30%), and leaves the target 4% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Shared Yoke
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: The Long Haul

riders.text: your wind comes back between furrows
the small hurts close while you work
and every task comes round again sooner

fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your stamina recovers 12% faster, from silver your health recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.
